payload.title: Read-only review: list every DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP record across the Autopilot event logs and summarise what each one means. Do not modify any files.

outOfScope: Every write, edit, delete or rename anywhere in the repository. This task is read-only; the deliverable is the review text returned to the caller, not a file.
.ai/reports/TASK-0006.md — do NOT create it. A report file is a file modification.
Any change to tools/autopilot/*, tools/control-center/* or .ai/schema/* even if the review finds a defect there. Findings are reported, not fixed.
packages/**, apps/**, and all Bigcapital application source.
.ai/runs/*/raw/** — raw provider transcripts and test logs are not event logs and are not the review population.
git history, other branches, stashes, and reflog. The population is the working tree at baseRef 483904dfb.

Carve-out, not a licence: the orchestrator's own append of lifecycle events to .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/events.jsonl is harness behaviour and does not count as an implementer write. The implementer appends nothing itself.
invariants: CLASSIFICATION BY TYPE, NOT BY SUBSTRING. A record is in the population if and only if its parsed JSON `type` field is exactly "DEFERRED" or exactly "BACKFILL_GAP". The literal strings also occur inside payload prose (task titles, notVerified strings), so any grep-for-the-word approach over-collects. This is the single largest failure mode of this task.

TOTAL PARSE COVERAGE. Every non-empty line of every in-scope events.jsonl is JSON-parsed. A line that fails to parse is reported as a parse failure with its file and line number; it is never silently skipped. Silent skipping would make the population look complete when it is not.

FILE COVERAGE IS ENUMERATED, NOT ASSUMED. All eight task directories are visited, including DEPLOY-PRODUCTION and TASK-0006 itself. A directory containing zero matches is reported as an explicit zero, not omitted.

EVERY REPORTED RECORD IS RE-LOCATABLE. Each entry in the output carries at minimum (taskId, seq, eventId, type, file path). A reader must be able to find the exact record without re-running the search.

PROVENANCE SURVIVES SUMMARISATION. Where a record carries `reconstructed`, `reconstructionConfidence`, `source` or `simulated`, those fields appear in the summary of that record. A reconstructed record is never presented as directly observed history.

SUMMARY IS DERIVED, INFERENCE IS LABELLED. The 'what each one means' text is grounded in that record's own payload. Any statement beyond the payload — about current status, whether the gap was later closed, or downstream impact — is explicitly marked as inference and attributed to the evidence it rests on.

ABSENCE STAYS VISIBLE. DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP records exist precisely to record work not done and evidence not obtainable. The review must not narrate any of them as resolved, superseded or harmless without a specific later event that says so, cited by eventId.
WORKING TREE UNCHANGED. `git status --porcelain` produces the same output after the review as before it, modulo the orchestrator's own TASK-0006 log appends.
falsifiablePredictions: POPULATION SIZE: exactly 5 records exist — 3 in .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl and 2 in .ai/tasks/TASK-0005/events.jsonl. If the review returns any other count, either my type-anchored scan or the review's collection method is wrong, and the discrepancy must be resolved before the review is accepted.

SUBSTRING SEARCH PRODUCES FALSE POSITIVES: a plain text search for DEFERRED/BACKFILL_GAP additionally hits TASK-0002, TASK-0003, TASK-0004 and TASK-0006. If the review reports any record sourced from those four files, it used substring matching and the invariant is violated. Conversely, if a type-anchored parse finds a genuine record in any of them, my count above is wrong.

PROVENANCE: at least one TASK-0000 record carries reconstructed=true with reconstructionConfidence=HIGH and a `source` string (confirmed for seq 33). Prediction: all three TASK-0000 records are reconstructed. If any TASK-0000 record lacks reconstructed=true, my model of the Stage-0 backfill is wrong.
NO SIMULATION: zero records in the population carry simulated=true. If the review finds one, its finding must be treated as non-independent evidence and flagged.

PAYLOAD SHAPE: every record in the population has both payload.what and payload.why (tools/control-center/server.mjs:242 and :245 render both for both types unconditionally). If any record lacks `why`, the control-center Not-Verified panel is currently rendering the literal string 'undefined', which is a reportable finding — and my assumption about payload shape is wrong.

COUNTER AGREEMENT: the per-task counts computed by tools/autopilot/report.ts:175-176 (gaps, deferred) and tools/control-center/server.mjs:400-401 equal the review's per-task counts. Divergence means either the tooling or the review is miscounting, and the tooling is the thing users actually see.

REPORT COVERAGE: the NOT VERIFIED section of .ai/reports/TASK-0000.md and .ai/reports/TASK-0005.md contains one rendered line per record found in the corresponding log. A record present in the log but absent from its report means the reporting path drops evidence — a real finding.
implementationConstraints: No file writes. No `>` redirection into the repo, no Write, no Edit, no `git add/commit/checkout/stash`.

Collect by parsing JSON per line and comparing the `type` field with `===`. Do not classify with a regex over raw line text. A regex may be used only to pre-narrow which files to open, never to decide membership.
Do not rely on `"type":"DEFERRED"` byte patterns either — that assumes minified JSON with no whitespace. It happens to hold today; it is not a property the schema guarantees.
Read .ai/schema/events.schema.json first and use its `type` enum as the authority for valid type names.
Report per-file counts including zeros, so coverage is visible rather than inferred from what was printed.
Treat .ai/reports/*.md as derived artifacts. They are cross-checks against the logs, never a source of records.
Order the output deterministically by (taskId, seq) so two runs are diffable.
If a defect is found in report.ts or server.mjs (for example BACKFILL_GAP rendering dropping payload.why at report.ts:126), record it as a finding with file:line. Do not fix it.
requiredTests: None. This task adds no production code, so there is nothing to unit-test. Introducing a test file would itself violate the read-only constraint.

In place of tests, the reviewer must demonstrate the count by two independent derivations: (a) a per-line JSON parse filtered on the `type` field, and (b) the counters already implemented in tools/autopilot/report.ts / tools/control-center/server.mjs. Both must agree, and both must be shown.
requiredRuntimeAcceptance: `git status --porcelain` captured before and after the review; the two outputs are identical apart from paths under .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/. Paste both.
`git diff` over the scope allowlist is empty. Paste the command and its empty result — an unpasted claim of cleanliness is not acceptance.
The review output lists all eight task logs with an explicit record count each, summing to the reported total.
For each of the 5 expected records: taskId, seq, eventId, type, actor, payload.what, payload.why, and provenance flags are quoted verbatim from the log, followed by the plain-language summary.
Cross-check performed against .ai/reports/TASK-0000.md and .ai/reports/TASK-0005.md NOT VERIFIED sections, with any log-vs-report mismatch reported.
knownUnverified: COMPLETENESS BEYOND THE WORKING TREE. This review covers .ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl at baseRef 483904dfb only. DEFERRED or BACKFILL_GAP records that existed on unmerged branches, were written to logs later removed, or live outside version control are invisible to it. The review can establish what the current tree records, not what the system has ever deferred.

TRUTH OF THE CLAIMS. The review verifies that each record exists and says what it says. It does not verify that the deferred work is still undone, that the evidence gap is still open, or that the stated `why` is accurate. Those are separate investigations.

SELF-ASSERTED CONFIDENCE. `reconstructionConfidence: HIGH` on the TASK-0000 backfill records is an assertion by the `backfill` actor about its own output. Nothing in this review independently validates it, and it should not be read as corroborated.
TAMPER STATUS. eventId is documented in the schema as a content hash of the record body, but this review does not recompute those hashes. Record integrity is therefore assumed, not demonstrated.

THE STAGE-0 STRUCTURAL GAP IS UNRESOLVABLE BY THIS TASK. TASK-0000 seq 33 states that reviewer miss rate and finding precision cannot be computed because unraised issues leave no trace. Listing that record does not close it, and no amount of re-reading these logs will.

SAMPLE SIZE. Five records across two of eight task logs is too small to support any claim about rates, trends, or whether deferral is increasing or decreasing over time. The review must decline to draw such conclusions.

findings.claim: The cleanliness acceptance criteria contradict the explicit lifecycle-event carve-out, so a compliant review can be impossible to accept.
findings.scenario: If the orchestrator appends a lifecycle event to the tracked TASK-0006 events.jsonl during the review, the before/after status difference is permitted by WORKING TREE UNCHANGED. However, the required unqualified `git diff` over the scope allowlist includes that same file and must be empty. Its result will be non-empty even though the implementer made no write.
findings.violatedInvariant: Acceptance criteria must be mutually consistent and must distinguish authorized harness mutations from implementer mutations.
findings.evidenceAvailable: The design expressly permits orchestrator appends under outOfScope and the working-tree invariant, while scopeAllowlist includes `.ai/tasks/TASK-0006/events.jsonl` and requiredRuntimeAcceptance demands an empty diff over the entire allowlist. Missing evidence: whether the harness appends to a tracked file in this particular run.

findings.claim: The required second derivation is not specified as an executable, population-wide observation, so merely showing counter implementation source can satisfy the wording without independently establishing the five-record count.
findings.scenario: A reviewer parses all logs once, obtains five records, then cites lines 175-176 showing that counters exist without running those counters against all eight logs or capturing their outputs. Both items can be 'shown' and claimed to agree, even if the reporting runtime omits a task, reads a different population, or is not invoked at all.
findings.violatedInvariant: The required count must be demonstrated by two independent derivations whose observed per-task results agree; source-code inspection alone is not an observed derivation.
findings.evidenceAvailable: `requiredTests` calls the implemented counters a derivation and says both must be shown, but neither it nor runtime acceptance identifies commands, entry points, inputs, or required captured per-task counter outputs. The design references counter source lines only. Missing evidence: actual CLI/runtime interfaces and whether either tool can emit counters for all eight logs without writing derived artifacts.

payload.reasoning: The inconsistency in wording is real, but the failure scenario as stated does not occur at baseRef 483904dfb, so BLOCKER overstates it. Runtime evidence outranks the reviewer's premise: `git status --porcelain` reports `?? .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/` and `git ls-files .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/` returns nothing, while the other seven logs are tracked. `git diff` only reports changes to tracked content, so orchestrator appends to the untracked TASK-0006 log cannot make the allowlist diff non-empty. The finding's own 'missing evidence' clause — whether the harness appends to a tracked file in this run — resolves against it. What survives is a genuine latent defect in the design: requiredRuntimeAcceptance states 'git diff over the scope allowlist is empty' with no carve-out, while outOfScope and the WORKING TREE UNCHANGED invariant both exempt orchestrator appends to that same allowlisted path. The exemption is expressed only in the status check, never in the diff check. The moment TASK-0006's log is committed — which is how the other seven logs became tracked — the two criteria contradict each other and a compliant review becomes unacceptable. This ties to the WORKING TREE UNCHANGED invariant, which already distinguishes harness mutation from implementer mutation; the diff criterion simply fails to inherit that distinction. Narrow the finding from 'acceptance can be impossible' to 'acceptance criteria state the harness carve-out in one check and omit it from the other; currently vacuous because the path is untracked'.
payload.requiredFix: Amend requiredRuntimeAcceptance so both cleanliness checks carry the same carve-out. Replace the unqualified diff criterion with: (1) `git diff -- <allowlist paths excluding .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/events.jsonl>` must be empty and be pasted verbatim; (2) `git status --porcelain` before and after must differ only in paths under `.ai/tasks/TASK-0006/`; (3) the review must record the tracking status of `.ai/tasks/TASK-0006/events.jsonl` via `git ls-files`, and state explicitly that while it is untracked the diff criterion is vacuous for that path and the status criterion is the operative one. No change to any tool or log — this is an amendment to the design's acceptance text only, and does not license any write.
payload.requiredEvidence: Pasted output of `git ls-files .ai/tasks/TASK-0006/` (expected: empty) alongside `git ls-files '.ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl'` (expected: the seven other logs), demonstrating the carve-out path is untracked. Plus `git status --porcelain` captured before and after the review with the only difference confined to `.ai/tasks/TASK-0006/`, and the pasted empty result of the amended `git diff` invocation over the tracked allowlist entries (the seven logs, `.ai/schema/events.schema.json`, the three reports, `tools/autopilot/report.ts`, `tools/control-center/server.mjs`). The fix is proven when both checks pass simultaneously with the harness append present.

payload.reasoning: The specification gap is real and I can name the fix, but the BLOCKER framing overstates the consequence. Real: requiredTests calls the implemented counters a 'derivation' and demands both be 'shown' without naming an entry point, command, input set, or captured output, and the COUNTER AGREEMENT prediction anchors only to source line numbers. Citing report.ts:175-176 satisfies the literal wording without any counter ever executing. Worse than the reviewer knew, the obvious execution path is barred by the design's own read-only constraint: `pnpm ai report TASK-XXXX` (package.json:20 → tools/autopilot/cli.ts:169-176) calls fs.mkdirSync and fs.writeFileSync into .ai/reports, which is a file write; and no read-only command prints report.ts's counters — `ai validate` (cli.ts:181-189) builds the report in memory but emits only integrity and byte-identity, not the counter lines. The design's per-task claim about server.mjs:400-401 is also inaccurate: those lines increment `m.system.gaps` / `m.system.deferred` as repo-wide totals inside metrics() (server.mjs:341-342, taskIds() at :141), not per-task counts; per-task DEFERRED/BACKFILL_GAP rendering lives at server.mjs:241-245. So the second derivation as written is partly unrunnable under the task's own constraints. Overstated: this does not leave the five-record count unestablished. Derivation (a) — per-line JSON parse compared on the `type` field — is fully specified, executable, read-only, and is the authoritative population. Derivation (b) is corroboration of the tooling users actually see; its underspecification degrades cross-checking, it does not invalidate the population or make acceptance impossible. Narrow to: the second derivation must be an executed read-only observation with pasted output, and the design names the wrong lines for per-task counts.
payload.requiredFix: Rewrite requiredTests item (b) and the COUNTER AGREEMENT prediction to specify executed, read-only observations rather than source citations. Specifically: (i) forbid `pnpm ai report` outright — it writes .ai/reports/<task>.md (cli.ts:169-176) and violates the no-writes constraint; (ii) for report.ts's counters, require `pnpm ai validate TASK-0000` and `pnpm ai validate TASK-0005` with pasted stdout showing integrity ok and 'report rebuild: byte-identical', which licenses reading the 'known evidence gaps' and 'explicitly deferred items' lines from the already-committed .ai/reports/*.md as the freshly-computed values; (iii) for the population-wide figure, require an actual GET /api/metrics against a running control-center (server.mjs:867 → metrics(), which enumerates every task dir via taskIds() and rebuilds per request, never storing), with the returned system.gaps and system.deferred pasted; (iv) correct the design text: server.mjs:400-401 are repo-wide totals, so per-task agreement must be sourced from the per-task path at server.mjs:241-245 or from the validated on-disk reports; (v) state that any task log lacking an on-disk report (TASK-0002/0003/0004, DEPLOY-PRODUCTION, TASK-0006) is covered by derivation (a) plus the /api/metrics total only, and log that limitation rather than implying full two-way per-task coverage. No code change to report.ts, cli.ts or server.mjs.
payload.requiredEvidence: Pasted stdout of both `pnpm ai validate` invocations; pasted JSON body of GET /api/metrics showing system.gaps and system.deferred; pasted per-line-parse table with per-file counts including explicit zeros for all eight logs; and an arithmetic reconciliation showing the parse total equals system.gaps + system.deferred, with per-task agreement shown for the tasks that have reports. Accompanied by `git status --porcelain` after these invocations, unchanged apart from `.ai/tasks/TASK-0006/`, proving the second derivation ran without writing — which is precisely what `ai report` would have failed.

payload.reason:
READ-ONLY REVIEW COMPLETE. No file was created, edited, deleted or committed. Deliverable is this review text.

=== 1. POPULATION: 3 RECORDS, NOT THE PREDICTED 5 ===
The design's POPULATION SIZE prediction is FALSIFIED and must be resolved before acceptance, so I resolve it here. Predicted: 5 records (3 in TASK-0000, 2 in TASK-0005). Actual: 3 records, ALL in .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl. TASK-0005 contains ZERO.

Evidence that the TASK-0005 half of the prediction is wrong, not my scan: TASK-0005's full type inventory across all 16 records is TASK_CREATED, STATE_TRANSITION x4, DESIGN_DECISION x2, DESIGN_REVIEW, ADJUDICATION, IMPLEMENTATION, POLICY_BLOCK x4, ESCALATION. No DEFERRED, no BACKFILL_GAP. Independently corroborated three ways: (i) the freshly-rebuilt TASK-0005 report counters read 'known evidence gaps: 0 / explicitly deferred items: 0'; (ii) live GET /api/metrics totals equal the TASK-0000-only figures; (iii) TASK-0005's own DESIGN_DECISION payload (seq 3, EV-1c66d798c7120800) states in its outOfScope that TASK-0002..TASK-0005 and DEPLOY-PRODUCTION 'contain no DEFERRED or BACKFILL_GAP events; their textual matches are prose references to the schema enum'. The prior review reached the same population.

The design's SUBSTRING prediction is CONFIRMED. A raw-text search returns 20 hits; 17 are false positives in TASK-0002 (1), TASK-0003 (3), TASK-0004 (3), TASK-0005 (5) and TASK-0006 (4), all inside DESIGN_DECISION/DESIGN_REVIEW/ADJUDICATION/IMPLEMENTATION/TASK_CREATED prose. Membership was decided only by parsed `type` ===, against the schema enum at .ai/schema/events.schema.json:15.

FILE                                       RECORDS  MATCHES  UNKNOWN_TYPE
.ai/tasks/DEPLOY-PRODUCTION/events.jsonl         6        0             0
.ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl                35        3             0
.ai/tasks/TASK-0001/events.jsonl                 2        0             0
.ai/tasks/TASK-0002/events.jsonl                 5        0             0
.ai/tasks/TASK-0003/events.jsonl                13        0             0
.ai/tasks/TASK-0004/events.jsonl                26        0             0
